title: search_code
description: Case-insensitive substring search for `query` across text files in the repository (or under `path` if given). Returns matching lines with file path and line number. Binary files and common ignored directories (node_modules, .git, dist, build, venv, __pycache__, .devagent) are skipped.

path.description: Directory to scope the search to, relative to the repository root. Defaults to the whole repository.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 50.
